title: Destruction and return of hypoxia off the Pearl River Estuary, July 2018
judge: Codex, single judge; procedure in benchmarking/evaluation/CODEX_JUDGE.md

paper.title: Destruction and reinstatement of coastal hypoxia in the South China Sea off the Pearl River estuary

period_match.paper_data: three cruise legs before and after Typhoon Son-Tinh
period_match.supplied_data: CMOMS model oxygen, temperature, salinity, chlorophyll and velocity

verdict_labels: not testable with the supplied data

criteria.title: Finding 1
criteria.claim: Before the typhoon the bottom water was severely hypoxic: oxygen as low as 3.5 umol/kg and about 660 km2 below 63 umol/kg.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'The lowest ever recorded regional dissolved oxygen (DO) concentration of 3.5 umol kg-1 ... was observed in bottom waters during leg 1, with an ~660 km2 area experiencing hypoxic conditions (DO < 63 umol kg-1).'
criteria.how_to_test: Daily bottom-oxygen minimum and hypoxic area (below 63 umol/kg, with the density conversion stated) on the inner shelf off the estuary for 8-14 July 2018.
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: hypoxia present; area within a factor of 2)

criteria.title: Finding 3
criteria.claim: Hypoxia returned about 6 days later, with bottom-water oxygen consumption averaging 14.6 umol/kg per day.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'quickly restored ~6 d later, resulting primarily from high biochemical oxygen consumption in bottom waters that averaged 14.6 +/- 4.8 umol O2 kg-1 d-1.'
criteria.how_to_test: Testable: the time for hypoxia to return and the rate of bottom-oxygen decline. Consumption can be separated from physical supply only with the evaluator-only oxygen budget (X_OXY) or stated assumptions.
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: return time +/-3 days; decline rate +/-50%)

criteria.title: Finding 4
criteria.claim: Shoreward intrusion of offshore subsurface water added about 8.6% to the oxygen loss.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'The shoreward intrusion of offshore subsurface waters contributed to an additional 8.6 +/- 1.7 % of oxygen loss during the reinstatement of hypoxia.'
criteria.how_to_test: Testable as the advective contribution estimated from velocity and oxygen gradients (or from X_OXY). The paper's mixing-model estimate cannot be reproduced exactly.
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: sign exact; share +/-10 percentage points)

criteria.title: Method fidelity
criteria.focus: The hypoxia threshold and unit conversion (umol/kg to the model's mmol/m3); the bottom layer and a shelf area matching the cruise region; daily series through the three cruise legs.

anchors.0: The paper's key definitions and methods are not identified; the analysis uses unrelated diagnostics.
anchors.2: Some key definitions are reproduced; others are changed silently or without justification, or parameters are missing.
anchors.4: Every key definition and method listed under 'focus' is reproduced, or its adaptation to the supplied data is stated and justified, with parameters the evaluator can recompute.

criteria.title: Differences from the paper's setting
criteria.focus: Model versus cruise observations; whether the model's wind forcing contains the typhoon; daily means; resolution near the estuary; the paper's rates come from incubations and a mixing model.

anchors.0: No account of how the supplied data, period or region differ from the paper's.
anchors.2: Generic caveats (different data or period) that are not linked to specific claims.
anchors.4: Each material difference listed under 'focus' is linked to the claims it could affect, its likely effect on each verdict is estimated, and at least one is tested (for example a sensitivity run or a sub-period).

anchors.0: No claim-by-claim result; numbers cannot be traced to code or outputs.
anchors.2: Verdicts are given but scattered or only partly traceable.
anchors.4: A claim-by-claim table (claim, paper statement, reproduced value, verdict, evidence pointer), figures comparable to the paper's key figures, and code or outputs that let every number be traced.

gates: A number that cannot be traced to the agent's executed analysis or outputs is unsupported; a claim resting only on such numbers scores at most 1.
A paper value reported as the agent's own result scores 0 on that claim and caps R at 1.
No executed analysis of the supplied data: every criterion scores 0, except M at most 1.
